prompt: Which statements about starter and organization workflow templates are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: A template is a starting point: the picker (GitHub’s starters plus your organization’s) copies YAML into `.github/workflows/`, after which it is yours. Nothing flows back later — when the template improves, you re-copy deliberately.

options.text: Choosing a starter workflow copies its YAML into your repository to edit
An organization publishes its own templates from its `.github` repository
Template metadata files control the category and description shown in the picker
Templates update your workflow automatically whenever the template changes
Only GitHub can author templates that appear in the New workflow list
